# Implementation checklist — exact remaining work

This is the reconciled build checklist. It is not permission to implement or release.

288 reviewed cards; 1625 per-card delivery/check references; 654 evidence-only shared-owner context references; 1672 distinct object labels; 4 named steps. These overlapping counts are NEVER summed. Context references have no implementation ticks and are excluded from the delivery/check count. One object may appear in several ordered successor cards. A reference is not a separate physical object or automatic new implementation. Existing accepted code is reused, not rebuilt without a named remaining change.

Every required row retains its precise existing-work status, current source evidence and remaining change. BUILT, REVIEWED, INSTALLED and TESTED are separate. All revised-target boxes start unchecked; the builder can close a reuse-only row by verifying its exact retained contract with no unnecessary edit. An old receipt or installed baseline cannot close an unfinished successor. Conditional owner-gated omissions are recorded, not counted complete.

The CSV contains every field, exact evidence and blank recording columns for implementation commit/date/evidence, independent review, installed TEST evidence and in-app results. Applicable build checks are individually ticked; N/A requires a reason. Stable row IDs are shown below. Do not renumber them on resume.

See §2; do not overtake command order.

**Later in-app acceptance — not run:**

Enter nets for 150 Candidates in three pages and Save: the header reads "Net entered 150 of 150" and the pill turns Complete once the background jobs finish (RQ-126, NX-093, NX-096, LSV-063 replaced); the window stays open (LUI-102), and the same edit works inline in the worksheet tab (LUI-105); the single-box control (NX-097) is gone. Saving 0.00 for one worker keeps "150 of 150" and shows GBP 0.00; blanking one and saving gives "149 of 150" and that worker shows "NET required" (RQ-404, RQ-123). While a re-save from GBP 400 to GBP 420 is pending, the worksheet and STATUS still show GBP 400.00 accepted with "Pending GBP 420.00" (RQ-400). The re-save works for a worker with no finance case and for a worker with a Payment Advance repayment alike: after it is accepted there is exactly one non-retired projection and the week fact carries GBP 420. Clearing a worker with no case and saving GBP 380 later is accepted. Clearing a PAYE worker whose GBP 50 Payment Advance repayment is reserved shows "NET required", "Build payments" is refused "PAYE net required", the GBP 50 reservation is still held (no other Draft can use it), and entering GBP 400 afterwards gives GBP 350 cash; cancelling that Candidate's payment after the clear (once EX-27 exists) releases the GBP 50. A stale `expected_projection_revision` is refused (RQ-324). After transfers are built for a worker, clearing or changing its net is refused. Save is hidden until something changes (RQ-122).

Cancelling all in a PAYE Draft of five Candidates where one has a CSV issued gives "4 cancelled, 1 blocked: bank CSV issued" (RQ-176, RQ-178, LSV-102, LSV-108, LUI-149 confirmation shown first); the four Candidates' work is offerable again with no net carried over and others' amounts unchanged (RQ-179; P08, P11; NX-126, NX-129); a Candidate with an Umbrella case leg and an external leg is cancelled across all legs or blocked whole (NX-127, NX-128, SRQ-214); submitting with nothing selected does nothing and a retry after a failed page completes (RQ-312, RQ-181, LSV-164); an unsealed selection can be discarded (LSV-106); the plan preview lists what would be cancelled (LSV-101); a Withdrawn Timesheet's Candidate can be cancelled (SRQ-168); the cancellation history per worker comes from the indexed lookup (RQ-330, RQ-286); a Candidate whose bank details were approved and bound (EX-06) but whose payment was not issued can still be cancelled through to the end (the week contribution shows Cancelled); each cancelled payment has exactly one CANCELLED fact with its prior status, and replaying the cancel adds none; a Candidate whose latest PAYE net was refused (DR-37), or whose net was re-entered, imported or cleared, with or without a finance case, can be cancelled on its last accepted projection. **Later in-app acceptance — not run:**

- Move A→B→C after A was paid 20: C's comparison shows R*=20 against A's position, and history shows one origin, not a chain (SRQ-137, RQ-228).
  - The posting table holds: settlement moves H→R; cancel and expiry reduce H by the reserve; write-off, return and reissue change neither R nor H (SRQ-138).
  - Reserve = q(R+H) − q(R), never q(H); paid = q(R); residual = E − total (SRQ-136).
  - Removing A while a pair is half-applied creates no full old debt, and a current zero never resurrects an old positive (SRQ-139).
  - A new book starts ZERO with no backfill; `bound_source_snapshot_v1` refuses `BOOK_POSTING_REQUIRED` for an unposted book (NX-018, NX-019, NX-042 book columns).
  - Cross-channel examples (assessment L39-41), two separate scenarios: (i) native Umbrella R20 with accepted PAYE comparable 17 and genuine N17 gives rho 0; a later genuine PAYE N20 gives 3 additional earnings before payroll (bank cash follows the accepted NET); after settlement native Umbrella R20 and PAYE R3 coexist and comparable R* = 17 + 3 = 20. (ii) Separately, from native Umbrella R20 / comparable R* 17 with genuine N14 (realised excess 3), an actual PAYE recovery of 2 records native PAYE R −2 and comparable R* 15, leaving 1 outstanding, while the original Umbrella realised scalar stays 20 and its original frozen transfer/cash remain unchanged. Replaying the same settlement or recovery returns the saved snapshot and advances nothing.
  - Exactly one definer of each of `bpay_next_bound_source_snapshot_v1`, `bpay_next_source_comparison_carry_v2` and `bpay_next_source_comparison_carry_known_work_v2` exists in BUILD-BE (the UMM1 bodies), and the F-04 gate names them.
  - A seed-channel actual event that makes native totals differ from the preserved seed scalar is read through the certified branch; an uncertified divergence still returns `BOOK_POSTING_REQUIRED`.
  - The manifest carries the PRIM erratum and the C29 closing-review line (C29, C30).
  - Joined future check: A→B→C retains one canonical A flat binding; settle/recover/cancel/expire/writeoff/reissue each updates correct native/comparable counters once; zero seed has no invented paid history. No new local fixture/hash proof programme; reuse one joined receipt where it covers several explicit clauses.

## Test in the app after the full build

# In-app TEST journeys — final plan checklist; all NOT_RUN

This is a future acceptance checklist, not a proof-testing programme and not authority to run it. Finish the implementation first. Use the separately authorised, isolated NEXT TEST agency, its actual Worker and queue, and the installed reviewed version. No real provider, bank, email or webhook effect is permitted. Use the approved contained rails; a CSV is a bank file, not proof that money reached a bank. Installation/security checks remain separate from these business journeys.

Every result is currently **NOT_RUN**. A journey can satisfy several card outcomes; do not repeat it once per card if one retained receipt covers the exact checks. Conversely, a generic happy-path result must not close unexercised variants. Do not add journey counts to the implementation-card countdown.

## Receipt and checklist rules

Record the exact installed reviewed version, agency/Worker, screen/action, Candidate/work scope, accepted order and captured revision, expected/observed amounts/states, relevant event/job/queue/tick, containment and covered card clauses. Installation/schema/security verification is a separate release checklist, not an app journey. Do not run real provider, bank, email or webhook effects; unavailable app authority pauses only its own scoped test.

This is the R2 final plan acceptance checklist, not R9/R10 historical acceptance and not evidence that any test ran. Keep all rows NOT_RUN until actual qualified receipts exist. No historical review, routine presence, module presence or owner-reported database-only timing gates new build completion.
